newsitem.title: UK: Ivana Trump's husband issues libel writ in England.
newsitem.headline: Ivana Trump's husband issues libel writ in England.

text.p: Ivana Trump's estranged husband, Riccardo Mazzuccelli, began libel proceedings in England against his wife and her ex-husband, American billionaire property tycoon Donald Trump, Mazzuccelli's lawyers said on Tuesday.
"Proceedings were brought today following defamatory articles in the U.S. and worldwide press published over the past three weeks," the London law firm Mishcon de Reya said in a statement.
Kate Day, a spokeswoman for the firm, said the articles which Mazzucchelli alleges are libelous appeared in two American publications, the National Enquirer and People magazine.
"The articles have been seen in Britain and are available in Britain," she told Reuters, explaining the reason for pursuing the case in England.
"Our client also lives in England," she added.

Mazzucchelli, 54, an entrepreneur and international businessman, is suing his wife and Trump because both parties are quoted in the articles which he alleges suggested that he was a gold digger who lied to Ivana to induce her to marry him.
Day said Mazzucchelli would, if he won, give the unspecified damages he is seeking to charity.
Ivana, 48, a Czech-born former fashion model and Olympic skier, spilt from Mazzucchelli earlier this summer. The couple were married in November, 1995.
She received more than $50 million in a bitter divorce settlement from Trump in 1990 after his highly publicised affair with former beauty contestant Marla Maples.
Trump, 51, and Maples, who married two months after their daughter was born in 1993, announced their separation in May.
